methodology: Real issuer, venue, protocol and source changes plus observed catalogue membership changes. RWA Sonar editorial corrections and transient watcher failures are excluded.

items.title: Tessera corrects its docs: T-Tokens have no Transfer Hook
items.summary: Tessera's on-chain-programs page and llms-full.txt now read 'T-Tokens do not use the Transfer Hook extension.' Until at least 2026-09-17 they claimed a Transfer Hook was enabled on all T-Tokens, which rwa-sonar had recorded as a documentation/on-chain mismatch because no hook exists on the mints.
items.whyItMatters: The docs now match the chain: nothing in the transfer path enforces eligibility, so transfers are unconditional apart from the 20 bps fee and the reactive freeze authority — which the docs' Authorities & Security table still omits.
items.consequence: The docs now match the chain: nothing in the transfer path enforces eligibility, so transfers are unconditional apart from the 20 bps fee and the reactive freeze authority — which the docs' Authorities & Security table still omits.
affectedHolders: holders of Tessera T-Tokens
items.before: docs: Transfer Fee, Transfer Hook, Metadata Pointer, On-Chain Metadata
items.after: docs: Transfer Fee, Metadata Pointer, On-Chain Metadata; no Transfer Hook

sources.label: Tessera docs, On-Chain Programs (watcher read 2026-09-22 16:47 UTC)

items.title: Backed lists Optimism as a tenth xStocks chain
items.summary: The issuer's legal-documentation page now lists xStocks on Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, Mantle, Ink, BNB Smart Chain, TRON, TON, X Layer and Optimism; on 2026-09-17 Optimism was on neither the xStocks nor the bTokens list. The dossier's chains field now has ten entries.
items.whyItMatters: Another chain means another deployment whose mint, authorities and bridge have to be checked before a holder relies on it; no Optimism mint is recorded in the dossier yet, and the Base Prospectus still names no chain list.
items.consequence: Another chain means another deployment whose mint, authorities and bridge have to be checked before a holder relies on it; no Optimism mint is recorded in the dossier yet, and the Base Prospectus still names no chain list.
affectedHolders: holders and prospective holders of xStocks on any chain

items.title: PreStocks doubled its on-chain transfer fee
items.summary: All eight PreStocks mints changed from 50 bps to 100 bps at fee epoch 1039. The maximum fee remains u64::MAX and the shared Squads-controlled address remains both transfer-fee configuration authority and withheld-fee withdrawal authority.
items.whyItMatters: Every transfer now withholds 1%, including wallet-to-wallet transfers and protocol movements. That directly affects exits, collateral transfers and liquidation proceeds.
items.consequence: Every transfer now withholds 1%, including wallet-to-wallet transfers and protocol movements. That directly affects exits, collateral transfers and liquidation proceeds.
affectedHolders: all holders and transferees of the eight affected tokens
protocol depositors, borrowers and liquidators moving those tokens

items.consequence: The programme has already wound down; loss of issuer-hosted metadata is another observable degradation while residual tokens and holders remain on-chain.

items.title: Remora's proof-of-reserves page disappeared with the programme

items.whyItMatters: A residual holder can no longer verify backing through the issuer's former live disclosure, so historical claims must be read as historical rather than current reserve evidence.

items.title: Backpack Securities: disclosure
items.summary: Backpack's own risk disclosure says tokens withdrawn to a self-custody wallet 'may be economically worthless to you' because redemption needs conditions that self-custody does not satisfy; ACATS/DTCC brokerage transfers, dividends, splits and voting are all listed as 'still being worked on'.
items.sourceNote: stocks/data/issuers/backpack-securities-spcx.json (T&C and Risk Disclosure Statement dated 2026-06-10; holdings page and FAQ read 2026-09-16)

items.title: Ondo Global Markets: pause
items.summary: 97 of Ondo's 212 Solana mints were paused at read time (reason unavailable_in_session, per Ondo's asset API); the Pausable extension and the freeze authority are the only compliance controls actually live on Solana, because the TransferHook extension is initialised with a null program on every mint sampled.

items.title: Shift leveraged tokens: governance
items.summary: All eight Shift mints were topped up in one ten-second batch by each mint's own hot keypair with a shared fee payer; no SHIFT program, oracle or proof-of-reserve account appears in the transactions, contrary to the documented 'PoR-gated' mint architecture.
items.sourceNote: stocks/data/issuers/shift.json (rpc:getSignaturesForAddress on the eight mint authorities)

items.title: PreStocks: rebase
items.summary: OPENAI's scaled-UI-amount multiplier moved from 1 to 1.4861347 at 16:30 UTC, restating every holder's displayed balance up by about 48.6 % without any transfer and without a public explanation. The issuer can unilaterally rebase balances.
items.sourceNote: stocks/data/issuers/prestocks.json (Solana RPC getAccountInfo on the OPENAI mint)

items.title: Ventuals Pre-IPO: wind down
items.summary: Ventuals sunset its pre-IPO perpetual markets; OPENAI settled at $1,341.80 and ANTHROPIC at $1,618.90 at frozen TWAPs chosen by the operator. Holders had no instrument that survived the shutdown.

items.title: Kraken xStocks: shortfall
items.summary: Binance, Bybit and Bitget cancelled their tokenized-SpaceX IPO campaigns after Kraken's xStocks could not source shares; Binance unwound roughly $557 M of subscriptions from 27,689 addresses with zero allocations. Backpack's SPCX, which had custodied shares through its own brokerage chain, was reported unaffected.

items.title: PreStocks: sector
items.summary: Anthropic and OpenAI declared SPV-routed transfers of their stock void and warned that tokenized exposure 'may have no value'; PreStocks ANTHROPIC fell about 34–38 % and OPENAI about 39–46 % within days. Tessera's T-OpenAI carries the same exposure question.
items.sourceNote: stocks/data/issuers/prestocks.json and tessera.json (CoinDesk and The Block, 2026-05-13)

items.title: Remora Markets: wind down
items.summary: Step Finance wound down all operations, including Remora Markets, after a January treasury compromise (about 261,854 SOL moved out of the project's control). Exit liquidity was posted on Manifest on 2026-03-02 at the prior Friday's close; residual supply and about 3,600 holders remain on chain.

items.title: Tessera: governance
items.summary: Upgrade authority for Tessera's token and referral programs moved from a Squads multisig to a single Fireblocks wallet, which now holds upgrade, mint, transfer-fee and referral-config authority across all programs and mints.
